items.evidence: Reservoir slot 1 and plate slot 2 loaded with the required labels; p20 left and p300 right with correct tip racks in slots 10 and 11.
Log shows 12 cycles of aspirate 100 uL from reservoir A1 and dispense 100 uL into plate A1 through A12 with the p300; no other wells touched.
Each cycle does pick up tip, aspirate, dispense, drop tip; no pipetting without a tip and no tip is held at the end.
100 uL is within p300 limits, apiLevel 2.15 is valid, and the simulation passed; the blow_out over the well top is safe.
The code does exactly the single requested transfer; comments and metadata accurately describe it, and the blow-out does not change the outcome.

judge.summary: The protocol matches the log: 100 uL from reservoir A1 to each of plate A1-A12 with the p300 and a fresh tip per well. All rubric items pass.
